summary:
RoomFit iteration 7 - frontend-only review of the new manual-room-editing + extended FURNISHABLE wizard at https://roomfit-1.preview.emergentagent.com on 390x844. VERIFIED on the live preview via the 'Try a Demo' sample 1B1B apartment (upload-continue-button testid is new, previously 'upload-continue').

Step 2 /plan/dimensions - PASS: Initial demo has 6 rooms. mode-draw shows the new add-rect-room-button; tapping it appended a 7th room ('Room 7 · Other · 4.0 m²') AND automatically switched the active chip to mode-corners (verified via computed backgroundColor: brandTertiary on mode-corners, white on mode-draw). The new rectangle is auto-selected (room-editor-card renders). Mouse-drag from the top-left corner handle moved that polygon vertex: after mouse.down/move/up the selected-corner-text read 'Corner 1 of 4 selected' and delete-corner-button appeared. Delete-corner reduced the polygon to 3 vertices without crashing. Dining room chip (room-kind-dining) is present among the ROOM_KINDS chips. Rename via room-label-input works and the room row re-renders with the new label. Remove this area (delete-room-button) brought the count back to 6 (initial state).

Step 3 /plan/rooms - PASS: The 'Auto-furnishing supported' badge now appears 5 times (living, bedroom, balcony, kitchen, closet) and 'furnishing not supported' only on the bathroom row - matches catalog FURNISHABLE=['living','bedroom','dining','kitchen','closet','balcony','hallway']. Selecting the balcony correctly does NOT show room-unsupported-notice (it is supported).

Step 4 /plan/furniture - MOSTLY PASS: Walk-in Closet flow correctly scopes to Closet (heading 'Walk-in Closet (Walk-in Closet)', Your selection = '1x Wardrobe · 1x Floor mirror' - matches preselect {closet:1} for wardrobe + {closet:1} for floor_mirror from catalog.ts). Kitchen flow correctly scopes to Kitchen (heading 'Kitchen (Kitchen)', 'Your selection: 1x Storage cabinet', Dining table/Dining chair/Bench/Plant appear under Optional - matches cabinet preselect {kitchen:1} and dining items being optional for kitchen).

SUSPECTED BUG (balcony furniture flow): On the FIRST visit from /plan/rooms, clicking select-room-balcony-r-bal + rooms-continue-button landed on /plan/furniture but the page title read 'Living Room (Living Room)' and the Your-selection line was the living-room default (1x Sofa, 1x Coffee table, 1x TV stand, 1x Chair/armchair=qty 1, 1x Lamp, 1x Side table, 1x Rug) - NOT the balcony preselect (expected: Chair/armchair=2, Side table=1, Plant=2 per catalog.ts line 22/35/42). The subsequent closet/kitchen flows worked because they did a page.goto('/plan/rooms') first (fresh render); balcony was clicked directly after confirm. This is reproducible and may be either (a) the balcony Pressable row not firing selectRoom() on the first click because its row position overlaps the floating CTA bar at ~2/3 scroll, or (b) rooms-continue-button navigating with stale state (demo defaults selectedRoomId to living and the subsequent balcony tap didn't commit before navigation). Playwright reports rooms-continue-button as 'hidden' - it is a Pressable div behind the sticky CTA shadow - and we fell back to a JS .click() which may be racing React state. Main agent should: 1) scroll_into_view the balcony row and retest manually, and/or 2) ensure the CTA's onPress reads the latest selectedRoomId (currently cta.disabled=!supported||!geom relies on fresh render).

Regression - PASS: Living-room demo path still enters furniture with the expected 7-item selection (Sofa+Coffee+TV+Chair+Lamp+Side+Rug).

Deprecated packages detected: none.
React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents deprecation console warning (carried over from iters 2-6, non-blocking).

ui_bugs.issue: On first visit to /plan/rooms (with Living Room auto-selected from demo), tapping select-room-balcony-r-bal then rooms-continue-button navigates to /plan/furniture but the furniture page is still scoped to Living Room instead of Balcony. Expected: Balcony page with Chair/armchair=2 (preselect), Side table=1, Plant=2. Reproduce from demo flow; closet/kitchen flows work because the test re-navigates to /plan/rooms first (fresh render).

rooms-continue-button and confirm-dimensions-button both report state=hidden to Playwright even though they are visually tappable. The <div data-testid=...> is wrapped so its visibility heuristic fails; .click({force:true}) also timed out, requiring a JS .click() fallback. Not user-visible but likely masks the race described above.

integration_issues.issue: selectRoom(balcony) does not deterministically commit before rooms-continue-button navigates - furniture screen opens with the previously-selected roomId.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' console warning on Style/Budget/Furniture screens (carried from iters 2-6). Non-blocking. Reference: console warning observed across multiple screens.

action_items: HIGH: Investigate balcony flow - verify that selectRoom(r-bal) commits before rooms-continue-button fires onPress. Options: (a) make the Pressable in rooms.tsx intent-safe by passing the room id into the CTA onPress rather than relying on store state, or (b) scroll the row into view / increase its hit target so the Pressable isn't competing with the sticky CTA shadow. Repro: Start Designing -> Try Demo -> Continue -> Confirm rooms -> tap Balcony row -> tap 'Furnish Balcony'. Expected: Balcony furniture list with armchair=2 preselected, side_table=1, planter=2. Actual: Living Room furniture page.

MEDIUM: Verify the WizardScaffold CTA DOM structure - Playwright sees rooms-continue-button and confirm-dimensions-button as hidden. Consider removing an outer wrapper that hides overflow or exposing the inner Pressable's testID directly so automated tests (and screen readers) can locate it.
LOW: Replace deprecated 'props.pointerEvents' with 'style.pointerEvents' in RN components to silence the carryover console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:110-121 addRect() correctly: sizes to 25% of imgW/imgH, pushes a new 'Room N+1' with kind='other', selects it, clears draft, switches mode to 'corners'. Verified end-to-end.

frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:82-98 onDragStart grabs the nearest vertex within 22/k px tol (handle size k Math.max(sw*3, 9/k) >= 9 display px), scrollEnabled={!dragging} on WizardScaffold freezes scroll during drag - good UX.

frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:50-69 corners-mode onTap inserts a vertex when a wall-segment is hit and otherwise selects the containing room; delete-corner guards poly.length<=3 with the 'needs at least 3 corners' error - matches spec.

frontend/src/components/PlanCanvas.tsx:42-54 responder: onResponderGrant -> if onDragStart returns true then dragging flag locks subsequent onResponderMove to onDrag; onResponderRelease routes to onDragEnd or onTap. Clean. Note the overlay View uses raw onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderTerminationRequest; iOS/Android should behave consistently.
frontend/src/lib/catalog.ts:46 FURNISHABLE=['living','bedroom','dining','kitchen','closet','balcony','hallway'] matches review ask; bathroom intentionally excluded.
frontend/src/lib/catalog.ts:22,35,42 Balcony preselects (armchair:2, side_table:1, planter:2) and Closet/Kitchen essentials match the review spec.

frontend/app/plan/rooms.tsx:22-25 FURNISHABLE gate + rank() correct, but the Pressable row only calls selectRoom(r.id) - navigation to furniture depends on the sticky CTA reading the updated selectedRoomId which may race on first tap (see bug above).

frontend/app/plan/dimensions.tsx:36,91,99-103 dragging state + dragV ref are mirrored (dragging + dragV.current) - minor redundancy but intentional (ref for render-less reads, state for scroll disable).
updated_files: /app/tests/playwright_iter7.py (stub only, actual testing done via browser automation tool)

success_rate.frontend: 7/8 review items pass. Add rectangle + auto-switch to corners mode + drag/add/delete corner + dining chip + rename/delete room + Step 3 'Auto-furnishing supported' labels (5 incl kitchen/closet/balcony, 1 unsupported bathroom) + closet/kitchen room-specific furniture lists + living-room regression all verified. BALCONY FURNITURE FLOW FAILS: tapping Balcony + continue lands on Living Room furniture page instead of balcony preselect (Chair/armchair=2, Side table=1, Plant=2).

seed_data_creation: None - uses the built-in 'Try a Demo' 1B1B apartment seeded by the plan-store.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Upload Continue testid is now 'upload-continue-button' (was 'upload-continue'). The home page has NO 'Try a Demo' button - you must tap 'Start Designing' first to reach /plan where 'try-demo-button' exists. The WizardScaffold floating CTAs (confirm-dimensions-button, rooms-continue-button, furniture-continue, etc.) are reported as visibility=hidden by Playwright and page.click force:true times out - use `el.click({force:true, timeout:1500})` wrapped in try/except, fall back to `page.evaluate((s)=>document.querySelector(s).click(), sel)`. For canvas-touch drag, after a fresh bounding_box, use page.mouse.move -> down -> stepped moves -> up with ~25ms sleeps. The balcony flow regression is reproducible from the Try Demo apartment: Start Designing -> try-demo-button -> upload-continue-button -> confirm-dimensions-button -> select-room-balcony-r-bal -> rooms-continue-button lands on /plan/furniture scoped to Living Room instead of Balcony. The same test but with a page.goto('/plan/rooms') before clicking balcony succeeds (because the fresh render clears selectedRoomId=living). Storage key is roomfit_state_v4; clear localStorage before each scenario.
rca_of_issue: Likely root cause for the balcony bug: on the demo path the plan-store defaults state.selectedRoomId to 'r-liv' (Living Room). Step 3's rooms-continue-button is enabled because !supported||!geom is false for living. When the user taps the Balcony Pressable row, selectRoom('r-bal') is dispatched but may not have flushed to the store before the user's second tap on rooms-continue-button fires onPress -> router.push('/plan/furniture'). Furniture screen reads sel = state.selectedRoomId which may still be 'r-liv' because the AsyncStorage persistence middleware in plan-store.tsx (see context_for_next_testing_agent) debounces the state update. Repro steps are in action_items. Mitigation: either (1) make selectRoom() setState call synchronous (useReducer flush) so the next event-loop tick sees the new value, or (2) have rooms-continue-button pass the just-tapped roomId as a prop to the CTA via local state in rooms.tsx (`const [pending, setPending] = useState<string|null>(null); const target = pending ?? state.selectedRoomId`), or (3) move the furnish action onto the Pressable row itself and remove the shared CTA for the rooms step.
